style_prefix: Richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink drawing, restrained watercolor, weathered fieldstone, worn brass, oak and wax, soft green daylight against blue-white mana and eerie glass-green roots, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical magical machinery, unlettered surfaces.

prompts.prompt: Wide dawn view of a low round fieldstone irrigation pump house built into a green canal bank, central brass-and-black-iron lifting engine visible through the west arch, blue-white crystal glow, south spring grate, east three-way water splitter, north cistern dome, east millcourse, two shallow stone holding beds and barley furrows in reed mist.

Inside a compact round pump house, a short chestnut-curled halfling woman in moss-green work vest stands on a fixed oak tread to read a high gauge, a broad halfling farmer in patched rust coat offers an oatcake by a low gate wheel, and a copper-bearded dwarf technician in leather apron inspects a red-wax governor seal on the central brass engine.

Playable work tableau: short halfling pumpkeeper stands between two sample bottles, low cistern and furrow gate wheels, waxed tally board, and dwarf technician's service lens; central crystal-powered pump glows while holding beds and barley furrows wait through the south doorway.

A short halfling pumpkeeper fills two stoppered glass bottles at the south spring grate and east delivery lip while a broad halfling farmer presses the same crystal-lot number into both wax collars; the village cistern gauge drops one mark behind them.

A short halfling pumpkeeper turns a low brass gate so water climbs a northern masonry cistern gauge while a broad halfling farmer rakes silt from two shallow stone holding beds and leaves their drain stones open; the southern barley course waits and a copper-bearded dwarf technician points to a delayed-flow schedule.

Two halfling farm workers share a low south gate wheel and a torn oatcake on the stone apron as clear water reaches the first barley furrow on schedule; the round pump house and blue-white crystal engine stand behind them in warm green dawn light.

A copper-bearded dwarf journeyworker in soot-brown leather apron calls pump measures beside an intact red wax governor seal while a short halfling woman in green vest records them on a waxed tally board; the east mill wheel waits still during inspection.

Low close view in a wet barley furrow: broad halfling farmer in patched rust coat and straw hat lifts a root with translucent edges on a small field knife, pale green light splitting through it; a glass-green weed unfolds by his muddy boot while a short halfling pumpkeeper traces the clear water route back to a steady brass engine.

A short halfling pumpkeeper pulls a low red-braided null chain beneath the central stone plinth; the black flywheel slows, blue-white runes close from right to left, delivery water thins to drops, and eight southern furrows remain dry behind one luminous wet row.

Clear suspect water spreads across two bare shallow stone holding beds under numbered willow stakes while the south furrow gate stays shut; a short halfling pumpkeeper braces the low sluice wheel and the narrow east mill wheel slows beside the round fieldstone pump house.

A short halfling pumpkeeper and broad halfling farmer measure one irrigation row between willow stakes as glass-green root hairs appear behind the advancing wet edge; the farmer closes the low gate at the last stake while a copper-bearded dwarf technician steps back from the visible change.

Inside the pump house, a short halfling woman and copper-bearded dwarf technician place two blue-white crystal cartridges in separate padded wooden boxes, pressing distinct fellowship and workshop marks into each wax collar while the brass lifting engine waits to reprime.

Tall lean human assessor in neat deep-blue travelling coat, brass bell badge, and waxed folio ducks under a low west stone arch; he sees a perfect central pump gauge first and a broad halfling farmer holding a luminous translucent root through the south doorway second.

A short halfling pumpkeeper leads a tall blue-coated human assessor along one visible route from spring grate to paired sample bottles, clear delivery lip, south stone apron, willow stakes, and glass-green barley roots; the assessor writes with his folio braced on one knee.

A short halfling woman pulls an iron bell rope above the pump-house west door as halfling farm households arrive along muddy ditch paths with irrigation keys, tally slips, handcarts, barrels, bundled infant and livestock buckets, forming an orderly witness line around a tall human assessor.

Close view of a copper-bearded dwarf technician cutting fresh red wax and opening a brass governor plate, revealing fine gold rune channels with faint glass-green after-lines downstream of a blue-white crystal socket; halfling hands steady tally board and two custody boxes while a tall human assessor leans close with open folio.

Wide noon pump-house tableau: perfect gauge over central brass engine, short halfling pumpkeeper between a tall human assessor's folio and a low shelf of samples, root jar, tally board and crystal boxes, copper-bearded dwarf at governor plate, broad halfling farmer in south doorway, willow-staked altered furrows visible outside.

Tall human assessor seals a thick joined claim packet beside paired water samples, luminous root jar, crystal numbers and route diagram while a short halfling pumpkeeper keeps the matching fellowship copy; the perfect gauge and changed field remain visible in one frame.

Tall human assessor closes a thin claim folio beside a perfect gauge and clear stone delivery lip; a luminous root jar and field tally sit outside the folio under the hand of a short halfling pumpkeeper, with glass-green furrow edges visible through the south doorway.

Late-afternoon irrigation scene: central crystal pump continues under an intact red wax seal, water fills the northern cistern and bare stone holding beds, a short halfling pumpkeeper closes the south gate, a broad halfling farmer stands by dry barley, and the east mill wheel is still.

Evening ditch path beside a silent round pump house: halfling farm households form a practical hauling line with barrel carts, small shoulder yokes, livestock buckets and ration marks; short chestnut-curled pumpkeeper carries two buckets while broad farmer rolls a barrel from the upstream ford.

Evening independent pump test: open brass governor plate with cut red wax, two separated crystal custody boxes, adult halfling enchanter in indigo work apron shaping blue-white mana through a temporary copper rune pattern on a stone board into one wooden test barrel, short halfling ledger worker, copper-bearded dwarf measuring channels, broad halfling guarding crystals, and tall blue-coated assessor recording the comparison.
